texts: On day 0 of Year 1, the night of the autumn equinox was clear and mild.
Keepers counted about twenty-five nightmoths at each lantern of the Cliff Path.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the East Row.
Three sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The three sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the East Row.
The nightmoth crowd at the East Row shrank.
Keepers counted seven nightmoths at the East Row at the third watch.
Each nightmoth that survived the hunt fled to the Hollows.

q1_issues.issue: The approximate count "about twenty-five" is encoded as (Cardinality (sk_mothgrp $x) (ParticleFromNormal 25 2.5)), but Cardinality is specified to take a native integer and distributions are reserved for measure magnitudes, not counts.
"shrank" is an internal change-of-state undergoer, so its intransitive subject should take Patient rather than Theme.
The locative "at the East Row" in sentence 6 is dropped entirely (no event Location and no entity-attached position atom), while the identical phrase in sentence 5 became an event Location.

q2_gaps: Approximate / hedged cardinality ("about twenty-five nightmoths"): Cardinality takes a native integer and CardinalityPhrase takes a numberless vague phrase, so a hedged exact count has no licensed form.

A universal ranging over a locative adjunct ("at each lantern of the Cliff Path"): the distribution machinery is stated for subject/object ranges, and it is not said whether the episodic matrix clause ("Keepers counted ...") should also keep a top-level group event the way a counted plural does — as parsed, nothing about a counting having happened is asserted anywhere.
An ordinal-named period of the night ("at the third watch") has no structured Time term and is not among the licensed day-part constants.
review.notes: Names, group/GroupOf handling, compound genus atoms, the collective-vs-distributive split, and the "the Hollows" Name-only plural label all follow the instruction set closely. The residual problems are the hedged count, the "shrank" role, and the dropped locative.

issues.reason: Cardinality's value slot is declared "a native integer" (*Cardinality*) and the counting-question rule states outright that Compute is the hard-integer test while GreaterThan "is for distribution values, not plain counts", so (Cardinality g (ParticleFromNormal 25 2.5)) is ill-typed per the stated vocabulary — the reviewer's aside that distributions are "reserved for measure magnitudes" is slightly loose (Time's Hour term takes one too) but the typing ground is decisive.

"The crowd shrank" is an intransitive change-of-state undergoer (the prompt's own Patient list carries weaken, fade, sag and the extent-change verb spread), and Theme is defined as a filler "with no change to it", so (Theme sk_shrink_1 sk_crowd_1) states something false of a crowd that got smaller; the Scalar-change carve-out does not cover it — the parse attaches no MeasureBy/From/To and the sentence states no figures.

The standing half is that the NP-internal "at the East Row" has a licensed static form under *Where a THING is* — containment "at" → (LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 east_row) — and nothing in the parse records it, so a stated locative is silently dropped; the "inconsistent with sentence 5" half does not stand, since sentence 5's PP sits after the verb's object where event Location is a licensed attachment and the two phrases are not in the same syntactic position.

gaps_confirmed: Hedged exact count ("about twenty-five nightmoths"): Cardinality requires a native integer and CardinalityPhrase requires a numberless canonical-lexicon phrase, so an approximated exact count has no licensed carrier.

A universal ranging over a locative adjunct ("at each lantern of the Cliff Path"): the distribution machinery is specified for subject/object ranges only, and nothing says whether the episodic matrix clause also keeps a top-level group event — as parsed, no counting is asserted to have happened anywhere.

An ordinal-named period of the night ("at the third watch") has no structured Time term and is not among the licensed day-part constants; the parse's bare third_watch symbol is acceptable improvisation under "a named time stays a bare symbol", but the construction is uncovered.
new_gaps: A time-varying group size: Cardinality is an untensed point value on a group symbol, so a passage that counts one set at two times ("about twenty-five ... at each lantern", then "seven ... at the third watch") and asserts the set shrank has no licensed way to attach a count to a time or to say that one group's size changed — the seven can only be a fresh group, leaving the shrunken crowd's size unrecorded.

A temporal of-phrase identifying a time by a calendar event ("the night of the autumn equinox") has no licensed head: the opaque Possession records a loose association only, and no Time term links the night to the equinox as its date.
An epoch-relative day index ("day 0 of Year 1") has no term of its own; it is forced onto the calendar day-of-month term as (Day 0), which reads as a nonexistent calendar date.
adjudication.defect_summary: For the hedged count no compliant form is licensed — Cardinality takes only a native integer and CardinalityPhrase only a numberless lexicon phrase — so the compliant move per *Core patterns* ("carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap") is to emit no count atom for "about twenty-five" and file the gap; for "shrank" the compliant form is (Patient sk_shrink_1 sk_crowd_1), the intransitive change-of-state undergoer role; and for the dropped locative the compliant form is (LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 east_row) beside the shrink event.
adjudication.notes: Everything else in the parse tracks the instruction set closely — the Name-only "the Hollows" plural label, the compound genus atoms, the group/count/distribution-rule pairings, the reified copular states with their flat dual-emit halves, and the sk_hunt_1 constant legitimately appearing in the sentence-8 rule premise because a top-level fact asserts it.
